name: windows-document-stack-diff-and-compact-view-parity
title: Windows Parity Handoff: Document Stack, Native OOXML/PDF/GB18030 Engine, Multi-Modal Diff, Scheme B 2-Way Merge & Fluent 2 Tactile Compact View
description: 1:1 Windows parity implementation of Apple (macOS + iOS/iPadOS) Scheme B Document Adaptation & Universal 5th Gallery Layout Mode ('compactList'): (1) Wire contract parity in charkle-core (GalleryLayoutMode::CompactList, expanded MediaKind::Document extensions & MIME detection, AssetRichMetadata.versionStack & AssetRichMetadata.document with 12-bucket minimapBuckets, uppercase RFC-4122 UUIDs & Cocoa Reference Epoch); (2) Local SQLite document_content_cache DDL & content_hash invalidation feeding assets_fts + Pinyin without polluting /.charkle/ops/*.jsonl; (3) Rust charkle-core + charkle-platform-win native parsers (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx via zip + quick-xml, .pdf text/scan flag, GB18030/UTF-16 via encoding_rs, Win32 IFilter legacy .doc/.wps/.xls/.et fallback), poster card artwork, Chinese office stem normalizer + 64-bit SimHash matcher, High-Risk Number/Currency/Date regex radar, Excel PK row aligner, WinRT OcrEngine scanned PDF hook, and Scheme B ZIP-preserving .docx/.md/.txt 2-Way synthesizer; (4) Tauri v2 IPC commands, CF_HDROP Primary Version copy/drag for WeChat PC, and Fluent 2 React UI (GalleryCompactView V2 2-col Bento / 1-col Folio, 3D micro-folio hover fan-out, 12-segment Diff Minimap, inline Revision Rail, Top-Edge Shelf & Gallery drop stacking banner, Ctrl+J -> Ctrl+C file copy, and Quick Look true-layout docx-preview 原版版式 ⇄ 结构与批注 reader, icon-gutter −/+ selective inlineTokens diff & 2-Way merge, and pdfjs-dist Red-Cyan / Split Curtain visual diff).
creator: CharTyr
notes: Keep all code edits strictly inside windows/ (and optional web/packages/shared/ follow-up if scheduled separately). Preserve 100% OS-agnostic compilation of windows/crates/charkle-core for android/rust/charkle-android-ffi without modifying windows/Cargo.toml workspace members. Canonical byte-for-byte sync & algorithm reference lives in docs/WINDOWS_DOCUMENT_SYNC_SPEC.md.
